positions.commentary: The speaker believes Amazon's business is getting better every day and is not egregiously overvalued, so he would hold a large position even if it comprised 95% of the portfolio.

thesis: This episode features Mohnish Pabrai discussing Amazon (AMZN) with MBA students, arguing that the company's business fundamentals are improving daily and that its valuation is not egregiously high. Consequently, he maintains a bullish stance, stating he would hold a large position in the stock even if it comprised 95% of his portfolio.
